authorizes: one bounded CPU batch of step-0 counterfactual studies on verified p1-17-train-full@1 groups; no training, no GPU, no Modal, no preference approval, no DEV/EMBERBench/locked-test data
owner_instruction: run 17 prompt, Phase 7: real counterfactuals, a bounded batch first, T1/T4 continuations
frozen_before: no study of this batch existed when this file was committed
state: step 0, the matched initial state of each group; interventions = the distinct STORED step-0 joint maps of the five teachers (counterfactual.step0_study); no live teacher call

selection.rule: the per_bin lowest-rank scenarios of each people bin of the collection plan (rank = the plan's preregistered salted hash)

horizon: the scenario's max_steps (run to termination); a branch still active at the horizon is censored

budget.branch_rollouts_max: sum over studies of alternatives (<= 5) x replicates; the verifier re-runs each once more

failure_policy: no retry; a failed or unverified study is recorded, counted and reported
verification: verify_shared_state_study: probe = the group's stored step-0 proposals, alternatives exact, every outcome/delta/censoring/verdict re-derived by replay, continuation RE-RUN
dataset: multiteacher_dataset.preferences -> class C/D records; preference approval stays disabled, so every class C is candidate_not_approved with weight 0
continuation_caveat: T4 has an internal CPU budget (2 s per decision); a budget-limited continuation decision can fail the re-run check; such studies are reported as unverified, not hidden
next: report only; a larger batch or other states need a new preregistration
